name: ticket-view-v1
description: body.ticket_view (message.schema.json): every case is checked against the schema AND the size cap (compact JSON, no spaces, UTF-8, of body.ticket_view alone, at most cap_bytes). ok=true: the relay stores it (201) and the workspace may send it; ok=false: the relay answers 422 invalid. Replayed by contracts/validate.py, relay/tests/ticket_view.rs and workspace/tests/test_ticket_view.py.
